next_action.description: Fix MPI-570, the hovered-gallery-video bug - Fabio asked for this first and for a fresh session to do it. READ tasks/MPI-570/brief.md BEFORE the card description: the description traces the wrong bug. His actual report is that pressing the flow button in the reuse box leaves whatever video sits under the mouse looping WITH SOUND while the Flow overlay is up - and that clip is not the one he was hovering, it is the card the closing popup UNCOVERS under his stationary cursor. Measured this session: mouseenter DOES fire on reveal under a stationary cursor (0 while covered, 1 on reveal). The trap: the card names `ui:close-all-popups` as a fix candidate and it fires BEFORE that reveal, so wiring the stop there would look right, ship, and change nothing. Hook OverlayManager.push instead, after instance.show() (js/managers/overlayManager.js:45-57) - depth 0 -> 1 is 'the gallery stopped being the visible surface' and every overlay goes through it. `_stopOtherGalleryMedia(null)` (MpiGalleryGrid.js:24) is already correct and needs no change; it is simply never called. Cover minimise and focus loss too (window blur / visibilitychange). Move the card todo -> doing and write files.json first.

key_decisions: ONE CONTROL SURFACE, and placement is a property - not a template DSL. Fabio chose the lazy option: delete the second name rather than unify two vocabularies into a third. The frame already owns the first and last slides; a FlowDef declaring them would be a step backwards and is what got reverted last session.

PROMPT-BOX HEIGHT IS A LAYOUT DECISION, NOT `rows`. `rows` is authored for CONTENT (a 3-line prompt beside a 2-line negative), so two boxes side by side under the preview came out different heights and read as a bug. Height is now set in CSS on the step row only; the stacked run-slide column keeps rows-driven sizing on purpose.
MPI-570's card description and Fabio's actual bug are DIFFERENT MECHANISMS. Do not merge them, and do not trust the description's fix candidate. brief.md is the authority now.
The second and third symptoms in MPI-570 (hover sometimes does nothing; audio arrives late) are probably three separate bugs, not one. Fix the overlay one first and do not assume the others follow.
GPU ETIQUETTE: Fabio asked at the top of the session whether anything here needed the GPU because another of his agents wanted it. Nothing was generated all session. Ask before dispatching anything.
constraints: playwright-cli DOES persist a session across `npx` invocations - use `-s=<name>` (e.g. `npx playwright-cli -s=mpi572 open <url>`, then `... -s=mpi572 eval ...`). The previous handoff's claim that sessions never persist, and therefore that every probe must be a single-line IIFE, is WRONG and cost that session real effort.

The shared `cubric-agent-profile` is often ALREADY HELD by a peer agent's instance. Losing that lock looks exactly like a broken app: exit 0 at ~2.3s, no window, 'Unable to move the cache: Access is denied' in the log. The fix is your OWN profile - `CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE=<own dir> CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT=G:/CubricModels npm run app:isolated` - never killing the peer. Check process CreationDate before assuming an orphan is yours.
NEVER pipe `npm run app:isolated` into head/tail/grep. It closes the pipe and kills the launch at exit 0, which reads as the lock bug and is not.

Bash tool: heredocs AND backslash-newline continuations are both BLOCKED by guard-shell (backslash halving). `python -c` with a Windows path in it dies the same way. Write the script or the commit message with the Write tool and run it by path (`git commit -F <path>`).

The media picker's tile click handler is on `.mpi-media-picker__tile-media`, not the tile - a synthetic click on the tile silently does nothing. Flow slide nav is `#flow-next` / `#flow-prev`; the ticker element is not clickable as a whole. Open a flow directly with `import('/js/events.js')` then `Events.emit('flow:open', {flowId})` - note `/js/events.js`, not `/js/services/events.js`.
